population: all available river files in the frozen English archive, not a performance-selected subset
reference_scope: project-aggregated UTC-day means; separate from provider-documented daily means
pair_eligibility: same river, station name and coordinates rounded to six decimals; distinct serials with at least ninety days of concurrent recorded timestamps
primary_role: lexicographically smaller serial; reverse direction is a sensitivity
natural_gap: missing daily record strictly inside the primary logger's recorded deployment interval; no transplanted or enlarged masks
reference_year: backup must have a finite qualified daily mean for every calendar day
original_upstream_history: at least three complete primary-only years strictly preceding target year
backup_input_rule: backup temperatures are reference only for primary-only reconstruction tests, never reconstructor inputs
operational_free_backup: also report the free backup-union reference; withholding a freely available backup does not establish an acquisition-policy advantage
risk_models: unchanged original source-only strictly-prior-year heads and thresholds; no local outcome adaptation
outage_causes: record gaps only; sensor failure, dry channel and maintenance causes require separate verified evidence
quality_rule: no agency-approved flag is invented; project aggregation and sensor-reference limitations remain explicit
independent_unit: conservatively treat the new provincial resource as one dependent cohort unless catchment/event independence is independently established
confirmation_claim: new frozen-resource descriptive stress test; not a population risk certificate or new broad superiority confirmation
costly_query_experiment: inactive without documented costs; public archive downloads are free inputs
